title: Model-Lab Condition Design v1
description: Machine-readable, frozen condition-contrast design for a future Model-Lab Run-004. v1 models exactly one honest state: a frozen paired design (design_status=frozen) that selects a single primary intervention axis (workflow_protocol) and two future arms (control=direct_implementation, treatment=spec_first) for the open weak_condition_contrast blocker. It is a design-freeze only: no run is executed, the execution environment is not bound, no result assessment is allowed, the series is not comparison-ready, and weak_condition_contrast is not resolved. The fixed v1 values (design_status=frozen; target_blocker=weak_condition_contrast; target_blocker_status_after_design=open; run_004_execution_allowed / result_assessment_allowed_after_design / comparison_ready_after_design=false; primary_intervention_axis.id=workflow_protocol with selection_status=selected and required_axis_count=1; freeze.frozen_before_execution=true; decision.status=frozen; decision.next_step=run_004_execution_readiness_may_be_assessed) are pinned as const so they cannot drift. The genuinely cross-artifact semantics live in the validator (scripts/docmeta/validate_model_lab_condition_design.py): exactly one condition_contrast_design_gate source (criteria_defined, design allowed, execution blocked, target open) and one blocked readiness_gate source for this series/challenge; exactly one control and one treatment arm; a material, pre-execution-observable workflow_protocol contrast and no second operative difference; complete control bindings for every non-primary dimension; shared common-condition / verification / measurement / intervention surfaces across arms; a valid, acyclic SHA-256 freeze manifest; safe existing repo paths; no execution artifacts in the design path; and the mandatory anti-overclaim non-claims.

triggered_by.$comment: Task or instruction reference that caused this design freeze. Non-blank reference, not const: provenance of the upstream gate is represented separately through source_evidence and semantic cross-artifact validation.

design_id.$comment: Stable identifier for this design (e.g. run-004-condition-contrast). An identity token, not a fixed const.

design_status.$comment: v1 models exactly one honest state: a design frozen before execution. A draft/superseded state would need its own data model and is intentionally out of scope for v1.

design_artifact_path.$comment: Canonical repo-relative path of THIS condition-design artifact. The freeze manifest binds and hashes this canonical path, so the freeze stays deterministic and independent of where the file is read from during validation.

target_blocker.$comment: v1 is specifically the condition design for weak_condition_contrast. The referenced gate and readiness artifacts must independently confirm this blocker is open.

target_blocker_status_after_design.$comment: Freezing a design never closes the blocker: designing a contrast is not executing or assessing it.

arms.$comment: Exactly two future arms. The validator additionally requires exactly one control and one treatment role, a material workflow_protocol contrast, and no second operative difference.

controlled_dimensions.$comment: Every non-primary experimentally relevant dimension, each bound identically across arms. The validator requires the mandatory id set and that same_value_across_arms_required stays true.

confounder_controls.$comment: Concrete confounder controls the frozen design commits to. The validator requires the mandatory ids, each carrying its declared effect_if_uncontrolled.

materiality_rationale.$comment: Why the contrast is material and pre-execution observable, grounded in the arms' workflow_protocol_spec process rules. No effect or superiority is claimed.

run_004_execution_allowed.$comment: A design freeze never authorizes execution.

result_assessment_allowed_after_design.$comment: Freezing a design does not authorize a result assessment.

comparison_ready_after_design.$comment: Freezing a design does not make the series comparison-ready.

source_evidence.$comment: Semantically: exactly one condition_contrast_design_gate and exactly one readiness_gate source are required, both for this series (and challenge_version for readiness), and both must be safe, regular, readable YAML mappings. assessment_context and method_context are context-only: only their existence as safe regular files is checked, never their prose.

does_not_establish.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. The validator requires the static baseline non-claims and forbids primary_intervention_axis_selected / concrete_condition_selected (this PR establishes those, so they may not be listed as not-established).

nonBlankString.$comment: Text must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

nonBlankToken.$comment: Token must be non-empty and contain no whitespace at all, including no leading, internal, or trailing whitespace (e.g. a trailing newline). '^\S+$' is intentionally avoided because Python regex '$' also matches just before a trailing newline, so it would accept a trailing LF.

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Rejected here as form errors: C0 control characters (U+0000-U+001F, incl. NUL/tab/CR/LF), DEL (U+007F), lone UTF-16 surrogates (U+D800-U+DFFF), empty, whitespace-only, leading/trailing whitespace, absolute POSIX paths, Windows drive letters, and backslashes. Parent-escape ('..'), symlink-out-of-repo, and filesystem resolution remain semantic resolver concerns. This is not a general Unicode/Bidi naming policy.

id.$comment: v1 selects exactly one primary axis: workflow_protocol. A different axis is out of scope for v1.

workflow_protocol.$comment: The condition value along the primary axis (e.g. direct_implementation or spec_first). Not const per-role here so that an operationally identical / cosmetic contrast is caught as a semantic violation (exit 1), not a schema error.

required_specification_sections.$comment: Empty for an arm that requires no upfront specification. The validator requires the treatment arm to carry the mandatory section set and the control arm to require no upfront specification.

binding_status.$comment: deferred_to_execution_readiness marks runtime values that can only be pinned just before execution; they still require a single shared binding source and identical values across arms, and execution stays blocked until a separate readiness check.

same_value_across_arms_required.$comment: Every non-primary dimension must be bound identically across arms; differing values are forbidden.

kind.$comment: condition_contrast_design_gate and readiness_gate are foundational (cross-checked and required to be readable YAML mappings); assessment_context and method_context are context-only (existence + safe regular file).

freeze_manifest_ref.$comment: Path to the freeze manifest carrying the SHA-256 of this design and every protocol artifact. The manifest never hashes itself (no cycle); this design references the manifest only by path, so hashes stay deterministically reproducible.
